description: Canonical raw/ source-artifact bucket taxonomy. scripts/lint.py reads this tracked file to validate that every raw/ subfolder is a known bucket.
policy: raw/ holds immutable source artifacts that Git may track with the rest of the wiki. Review sensitive files before adding or pushing them. Complete backups use the export workflow.

buckets.customer-research: Customer interview notes, support findings, and user research
buckets.ai-research: Example AI research and workflow sources, if present in this checkout
buckets.social: Example social or screenshot captures, if present in this checkout
buckets.videos: Example video transcript captures, if present in this checkout
